verdict.rationale: Supabase documents the pgvector Postgres extension for both storing embeddings and running vector similarity search inside the project's own Postgres database, so no separate vector database is needed. The agent-skills catalog also lists a Vectors category, which corroborates that this is a first-class capability. Missing for 10: detail on vector indexing (e.g. HNSW/IVFFlat) and query/distance operators, independent or hands-on corroboration of similarity search working at scale.
